name: Ardentec Corporation
summary: Ardentec Corporation engages in the provision of semiconductor testing solutions in memory, logic, and mixed-signal ICs to integrated device manufacturers, pure play wafer foundry companies, and fabless design companies in the United States, Taiwan, Singapore, Korea, China, Europe, and internationally.
